name: Awa Hime
source:
A beautiful dancer who always attracts attention at Awa Odori Festival.
However, she is not a member of any other group and has a mysterious atmosphere.
The name Awa Hime is derived from the name of Tokushima during the Ritsuryo period, but of course it is not a real name.
The real reason Awa Hime is her name, is just "Queen of Soap"
